description: Unified Configuration Manifest & Principle of Least Privilege (PoLP) File Access Matrix

development_rules.frontend_coverage_policy: CRITICAL: Any feature that adds user-configurable settings (fields in API schema, seller model, or any model exposed to users) MUST include corresponding changes to frontend/index.html in the SAME implementation task. This includes: form inputs, edit population (editSeller/editXxx JS), save payload (saveSeller/saveXxx JS), and table/list display columns. Omitting frontend changes for backend-added settings is a defect and must not happen.

holistic_impact_analysis.policy: REQUIRED: Before implementing ANY change, the agent MUST perform a full project impact scan. The agent must explicitly list every layer of the system that the change touches or might touch, and confirm that changes are applied to ALL affected layers in a single task.
layers_to_scan: app/models/        вЂ” ORM models, DB schema
app/schemas/       вЂ” Pydantic validation, API contracts
app/api/           вЂ” FastAPI endpoints, request/response handling
app/agents/        вЂ” Celery tasks, background workers
app/services/      вЂ” Business logic, external API clients
app/celery_app.py  вЂ” Beat schedule, task routing, includes
agents_config.json вЂ” Agent registry, development rules
frontend/index.html вЂ” All UI: forms, tables, JS save/load logic
tests/             вЂ” Existing and new tests
docs/              вЂ” README, API docs if applicable
required_pre_implementation_steps: 1. Read and understand the user request fully.
2. Search the entire project for all files related to the feature area (models, schemas, api, agents, services, frontend, tests).
3. List every file that will need to change and WHY.
4. Identify implicit side effects (e.g., adding a model field requires: migration, schema, API, frontend form, frontend table, tests).
5. Document findings in the implementation plan before writing any code.

post_change_test_analysis.policy: REQUIRED: After completing any implementation, the agent MUST analyze what tests are needed and implement them. Tests are not optional вЂ” a feature is not complete without corresponding test coverage.
required_post_implementation_steps: 1. List every changed or new module/function/endpoint.
2. For each changed unit, identify what behavior needs to be verified.
3. Check tests/ directory for existing coverage вЂ” extend rather than duplicate.
4. Write new tests covering: happy path, edge cases, validation errors, and integration with adjacent components.
5. Run existing tests to confirm no regressions introduced.
6. Document which tests were added and why in the walkthrough or task notes.

test_categories.integration: API endpoint + DB round-trip, Celery task execution
test_categories.schema: Pydantic validation rules, field constraints, timezone validators
test_categories.frontend_contract: Verify API response shape matches what frontend JS expects
test_categories.regression: Existing tests must still pass after every change

post_change_test_analysis.test_file_convention: tests/test_<feature_area>.py вЂ” group tests by feature domain, not by layer

token_efficient_codebase_indexing.policy: REQUIRED: To prevent excessive token consumption when analyzing the project, agents must NEVER read full files indiscriminately across the codebase. Agents must use the two-tier index (codebase_index.json and CODEBASE_MAP.md) or lookup_code_symbol() for preliminary discovery, and only read specific targeted files when their relevance is confirmed.
token_efficient_codebase_indexing.automatic_maintenance_policy: REQUIRED: Whenever any code or configuration file is created, modified, or deleted, the codebase index MUST be updated via CodebaseIndexer().save_index() to maintain 100% synchronization of all symbols, classes, functions, routes, and tasks.
required_steps: 1. Discover relevant files via codebase_index.json or CODEBASE_MAP.md by symbol/layer/endpoint.
2. Read only the confirmed target source file(s).
4. Run CodebaseIndexer().save_index() to refresh codebase_index.json and CODEBASE_MAP.md.
5. Run tests to ensure index and code integrity.

implementation_checklist: [ ] Pre-change: holistic project scan completed, all affected layers identified
[ ] Two-tier lookup used (codebase_index.json / CODEBASE_MAP.md) to minimize token consumption
[ ] Frontend EDIT population JS updated (load existing values into form)
[ ] Frontend SAVE payload JS updated (send new fields to API)
[ ] Frontend TABLE/LIST display updated (show new fields in rows)
[ ] agents_config.json updated if new agent or rule added
[ ] Instructions & docs updated (DEPLOY_VPS_GUIDE.md, README.md, docs/ if affected)
[ ] Codebase index updated (codebase_index.json & CODEBASE_MAP.md via CodebaseIndexer)
[ ] Post-change: test analysis completed, new tests written and passing
[ ] GitHub sync: changes committed and pushed to remote repository (AnanyevMA/WB_FBS_VRTN)

github_sync_and_documentation_policy.policy: REQUIRED: Whenever ANY code, configuration, database schema, script, or environment variable is modified, added, or removed, the agent MUST perform two mandatory actions: (1) Keep all user guides, deployment manuals, and documentation strictly up-to-date in the SAME task (DEPLOY_VPS_GUIDE.md, README.md, docs/, codebase_index.json, CODEBASE_MAP.md); (2) Ensure all modified and relevant project files are committed with a clear commit message and pushed to the GitHub repository (https://github.com/AnanyevMA/WB_FBS_VRTN) on branch 'main'.
required_steps: 1. Identify whether changes affect architecture, models, APIs, deployment scripts, environment variables, or operations.
2. Update corresponding user guides and instructions (DEPLOY_VPS_GUIDE.md for VPS setup/commands, README.md for overview/quickstart, docs/ for architectural references).
3. Run CodebaseIndexer().save_index() to ensure codebase_index.json and CODEBASE_MAP.md stay 100% synchronized.
4. Run full pytest suite to verify no regressions.
5. Stage changed files, commit with descriptive message, and push to GitHub remote origin main.

documentation_targets.deployment_and_vps: DEPLOY_VPS_GUIDE.md — server setup, cron, systemd, docker compose, memory tuning
documentation_targets.general_and_quickstart: README.md — system features, tech stack, quick start, API overview
documentation_targets.architecture_and_rules: docs/ARCHITECTURE_PLAYBOOK.md and agents_config.json — agent registry, PoLP, workflow rules
documentation_targets.knowledge_base: docs/ — API references, troubleshooting, recipes, docs/INDEX.json
documentation_targets.codebase_map: codebase_index.json and CODEBASE_MAP.md — symbol maps, routes, classes, tasks
